ai_positioning.summary: Berkshire Hathaway does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. References are primarily related to financial activities, investments and business operations.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulation in countries where it operates, particularly in the United States. Changes in regulation can significantly impact business activities. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Strict regulatory environment affecting insurance, utilities and financial operations.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk through insurance and reinsurance operations. Counterparty defaults can impact financial results. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Credit exposure from insurance underwriting and investment portfolios.

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: Berkshire operates in competitive markets where competition can impact pricing and margins across multiple business segments. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Competitive pressure in insurance, utilities, rail and manufacturing segments.

risks.title: Catastrophic Loss Risk
risks.score_rationale: Significant exposure to catastrophic losses through insurance and reinsurance operations. Natural disasters and major events can materially impact results. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Material exposure to catastrophic losses from insurance underwriting.

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Business decisions and operations could impact reputation with customers and investors. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Reputation tied to ethical business practices and stakeholder treatment.

risks.title: International Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Berkshire operates internationally and is subject to varying regulatory regimes. International regulatory changes could impact operations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Exposure to international regulatory changes across multiple jurisdictions.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Limited liquidity risk given substantial cash reserves and credit position, but insurance underwriting liabilities could create timing mismatches. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Low liquidity risk mitigated by strong cash position and investment portfolio.

governance.voting_structure: Deux classes d'actions avec droits de vote différents : Class A (1 vote par action) et Class B (1/10 000e de vote par action), votant ensemble en tant que classe unique.

comp_detail.perf_metrics_bonus: Aucun bonus ni remuneration en actions pour le CEO; salaire fixe de 100 000 $ inchange depuis plus de 40 ans.
